title: Empathy Modeling in Active Inference Agents for Perspective-Taking and Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on the computational modeling and evaluation of 'empathy' and 'alignment' with human values in artificial agents. It uses the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma as a framework to evaluate prosocial behavior, altruism, and ethical decision-making (cooperation versus exploitation) in agents, making ethics and alignment the central themes of the study.
